review.tagline: Small deep learning stack with tensors, autograd, and a readable compiler
review.summary: tinygrad is a Python tensor library with autograd, an IR and compiler that fuses and lowers kernels, a JIT (TinyJit) with graph execution, and nn, optim and dataset modules for training. It targets OpenCL, CPU, Metal, CUDA, AMD, NV, QCOM and WebGPU, and a new backend needs about 25 low-level ops. The API follows PyTorch, but the compiler and IR are kept small enough to read and modify.
review.audience: Engineers who want a hackable PyTorch alternative or a compiler to study
strengths: Whole compiler and IR are visible and hackable, unlike PyTorch
Eager Tensor API and autograd close to PyTorch, so training loops look familiar
Backends for OpenCL, CPU, Metal, CUDA, AMD, NV, QCOM and WebGPU
New accelerator needs only about 25 low-level ops
weaknesses: Fewer functional transforms than JAX: no full vmap or pmap yet
README says the library is not 1.0 yet
Recommended install is from source; no PyPI instructions in the README
Strict contribution rules: AI-looking PRs from new contributors are closed
needs: Models: OpenCL, CPU, Metal, CUDA, AMD
